facts.fact: The EPF interest rate for FY 2025-26 is 8.25% per annum
facts.quote: After due deliberations, CBT recommended 8.25 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: It is the same as the FY 2024-25 rate of 8.25%
facts.quote: The rate of interest on EPF deposits for FY 2024–25 has been declared at 8.25%.

facts.fact: The rate was recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees at its 239th meeting (PIB, 2 Mar 2026)
facts.quote: Posted On: 02 MAR 2026 3:37PM by PIB Delhi Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 239th meeting of Central Board of Trustees (CBT)

facts.fact: The 8.25% rate for FY 2025-26 has since been officially notified (News On AIR, 1 July 2026)
facts.quote: News On AIR | July 1, 2026 9:39 PM EPFO notifies 8.25% interest rate on EPF deposits for FY 2025-26

summary: 8.25% for FY 2025-26 (same as 2024-25) confirmed on PIB 2 Mar 2026 (239th CBT); notification reported by News On AIR on 1 July 2026; no change.
